# Camera shots for Round 1 (round1) and rounds 2+ (Warmup Cinematic Angles). Ctrl+F9 rereads this file.
# Which shot plays: p1dom / p2dom when the leader is one win from the match and the other has none; final at
# (N-1)-(N-1); otherwise var1, var2, var3 or var4, 25% each, never the previous round's variation.
# var4 = the game's own swoop as keys (delete the var4 shot to get the game's own camera back).
# Round 1 plays round1 (without it: the built-in dolly, warmup_cam_curve). Testing: [modifiers] warmup_cam_force=<shot name> in t7ghost.ini
# (or "vanilla" for the game's swoop) plays that shot in every round 2+; empty = normal.
#
# key <frame> <dist> <orbit> <elev> <focus> <lookh>
#   frame  frames from "Round N" (60 a second; the call phase lasts 168 frames, the last 30 ease into the battle view)
#   dist   distance as a multiple of the battle camera's (1 = battle view; Camera Distance applied like curve 6)
#   orbit  degrees around the fighters; > 0 swings toward P2's side, < 0 toward P1's side
#   elev   degrees above the fighters (camera height angle)
#   focus  aim shifted toward P2 in mm (< 0 = toward P1)
#   lookh  aim raised in mm (e.g. thousands = looking at the sky)
# Values glide smoothly from key to key; the last key should be the battle view: <frame> 1 0 0 0 0.
# If P1 / P2 come out mirrored, change p2side to -1.
p2side 1

shot round1     # Round 1: the forward dolly (built-in curve 6 as 18 keys, within 1 cm of it). Delete this shot
                # to get the built-in dolly back ([modifiers] warmup_cam_curve 3-6).
push 95 0.5     # push <frame> [strength]: the final push starts at <frame>. Away from 100% Camera Distance,
                # strength 1.0 grows the fighters on screen by as much as at 100% (strongest push, hardest
                # landing), 0.0 = plain scaling (softest), 0.5 = in between. Delete for plain scaling.
